item.tib: yang snying gsang ba'i thugs sgrub las lag len zla dkar 'od snying
item.coloph: ces pa'i dkyil 'khor lag len zla dkar 'od snying 'di ni/ mchog sprul nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang mkha' 'gro dbang gi sgron ma dang g.yung drung dpal ldan sogs kyis bskul ngor/ nyag rong bon gter gsang sngags gling pas bris pa/ dge des rgyal bstan dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig ces kyi yi ge ris byed thog mar mchog sprul bstan 'dzin bgyis pa'o//
